paper.title: Explicit quantum circuits for block encodings of differential operators with Robin boundaries

rows.plain: Write the banded sparse column address into an n-qubit register while preserving the row register.
rows.reading: The register extraction, address range, row preservation, clean-source split, and matrix image are compiled. A full unitary extension over every non-clean padded input and the corresponding dagger cleanup remain explicit contracts.

rows.plain: Flip one indicator qubit exactly on rows in the bulk window K1 through K2.
rows.reading: Lean proves the finite image is self-inverse, hence bijective, and that the corresponding matrix is a permutation matrix. This closes the local unitary, not the whole Robin block encoding.

rows.plain: Encode each exceptional Robin-boundary coefficient with a controlled y rotation.
rows.reading: The source formula and both angle conventions are represented and audited. With the standard Ry(theta) matrix, the clean amplitude is cos(theta/2), not cos(theta). The source-faithful gate-level route therefore needs a convention clarification or a cited doubled-angle correction.

rows.plain: The theorem fixes the target operator, normalizer, signal width, zero error, gate scaling, and pure-ancilla count.
rows.reading: The theorem statement and resource/layout equalities compile as typed data. The final projected-block equality is still conditional on the named sparse-access, amplitude-oracle, boundary-rotation, cleanup, and composition contracts.

rows.plain: After derivative, coefficient, swap, and cleanup operations, the clean branch should contain f(x_i) D_i^(s) divided by the three normalizers.
rows.reading: Lean records the gamma transcript and several finite projection bridges. It also proves that a historical H-free raw-entry equality is false, so that route is retired rather than promoted as the paper theorem.

rows.plain: The theorem-facing circuit keeps sparse preparation, the indicator and its inverse, derivative amplitudes, boundary rotations, sparse access, coefficient loading, swap, and cleanup in source order.
rows.reading: The labeled circuit transcript and the active seven-gate backend order compile. Compiling an ordered list does not establish that every labeled oracle has the paper semantics or that their product satisfies the final block contract.

rows.plain: Freeze the normalized N=8 matrix, then check independent five-shift and Hadamard-8 weighted-permutation decompositions entry by entry.
rows.reading: Hadamard-8 and four-slot high-level logical unitaries are exact T2 roots. The evolved XOR four-slot route additionally has an exact `{X,RY(theta),RZ(theta),CX}` T3 refinement and verified block encoding. This does not close the distinct paper-seven/Figure-4 source route or prove a same-tier source comparison.
